name: Google Analytics
why_it_matters: Collects visitor behavior; may need consent under GDPR/CCPA.

name: Google Tag Manager
why_it_matters: Loads other tags dynamically — tag governance is critical when GTM is present.

name: Google Ads / DoubleClick
why_it_matters: Ad targeting and conversion tracking; high privacy sensitivity.

name: Meta Pixel
why_it_matters: Retargeting and conversion tracking across Meta platforms.

name: Adobe Analytics / Experience Cloud
why_it_matters: Enterprise analytics and audience data; often tied to Adobe identity graph.

name: Adobe Launch / Tags
why_it_matters: Tag management container — can load many downstream trackers from one script.

name: Optimizely
why_it_matters: A/B testing and experimentation; can track user behavior and variants.

name: Chartbeat
why_it_matters: Real-time audience analytics common on news sites.

name: Parse.ly
why_it_matters: Content analytics for publishers; tracks reading behavior.

name: Comscore
why_it_matters: Audience measurement; shares data with industry partners.

name: Hotjar
why_it_matters: Session recordings and heatmaps may capture PII if misconfigured.

name: Microsoft Clarity
why_it_matters: Session replay and heatmaps similar to Hotjar.

name: Segment
why_it_matters: Customer data platform — forwards events to many downstream vendors.

name: HubSpot
why_it_matters: Marketing automation; can tie web visits to CRM contacts.

name: LinkedIn Insight
why_it_matters: B2B ads and conversion tracking on LinkedIn.

name: Twitter / X Pixel
why_it_matters: Ad conversion and audience building on X.

name: TikTok Pixel
why_it_matters: Advertising attribution for TikTok ads.

name: Amazon Advertising
why_it_matters: Amazon ad network and attribution pixels.

name: Criteo
why_it_matters: Retargeting ads based on browsing history.

name: Taboola
why_it_matters: Content recommendation ads; tracks clicks and impressions.

name: Outbrain
why_it_matters: Sponsored content widgets; behavioral targeting on news sites.

name: OneTrust / Cookie Consent
why_it_matters: Consent management — important for GDPR; still loads scripts that affect page behavior.

name: Snowplow
why_it_matters: First-party style analytics pipeline; can send data to your own warehouse.

name: New Relic Browser
why_it_matters: Real user monitoring; captures performance and JS errors.

name: Cloudflare Zaraz
why_it_matters: Third-party tag gateway; shifts where tags load from.

name: YouTube Embed
why_it_matters: Embedded video may set Google cookies before user plays.

name: Cloudflare CDN
why_it_matters: CDN delivery; lower risk unless analytics (Zaraz) is enabled.
